description: Register a repo as a gardenio project: sign in, pick the type:account bead, then gb project create with --dry-run and for real. The manual form is the Onboard section of .claude/skills/gardenio/SKILL.md (step 6).

vars.name: project
vars.description: Project name; becomes the type:project bead and the project:<name> label

vars.name: git_url
vars.description: Git remote URL of the repo, e.g. the output of `git remote get-url origin`

vars.name: account
vars.description: type:account bead that holds the LLM credentials; confirmed at the pick-account gate

vars.name: default_branch
vars.description: Branch agents clone and branch from

steps.title: Sign in to the gardenio daemon as a gardenio-admin
steps.description:
Human step: only the person can do this.

1. Export the daemon and the person the writes are attributed to:
   ```sh
   export BEADS_HTTP_URL=<daemon URL>
   export BEADS_OPERATED_BY=oidc:<your email>
   ```
2. Run `gb login` (or `kd login`; it is the same Keycloak device code). Open the printed link in your own browser and sign in. kd and gb then send your token and refresh it themselves. A deployment that uses a static bearer instead takes `GARDENIO_TOKEN`; never paste it into a bead.

Creating a project needs an OIDC token with the `gardenio-admin` role. The daemon refuses it on the shared static token and on fleet tokens (403, "requires gardenio-admin").

Close this step once `gb prime` names you, not a service identity.

steps.title: Check the daemon, identity and git remote for {{project}}
steps.description:
Run from the repo root:

```sh
kd --version; gb --version     # both present, same calver
gb ping                       # nonzero exit = daemon unreachable
gb prime                      # must name the signed-in person
git remote get-url origin     # must match {{git_url}}
```

If anything fails, use the Doctor section of the gardenio skill. Close this step when every line is ok.

steps.title: List the type:account beads that could hold {{project}}'s LLM credentials
steps.description:
```sh
kd list --type account
```

Comment the candidates on the pick-account step so the person can choose. The formula was poured with account `{{account}}`; say whether it is in the list.

steps.title: Pick the account bead for {{project}}

gate.prompt: Which type:account bead should this project use for its LLM credentials?

options.label: The account given when the formula was poured
A different account (name it in the answer)

steps.description: Decision for the person. The formula was poured with `--var account={{account}}`; the candidates are on this step's comments. If the answer is `other`, use the account it names in place of `{{account}}` in the next two steps.

steps.title: Dry-run gb project create {{project}}
steps.description:
Validate without writing. From the repo root:

```sh
gb project create {{project}} --git-url {{git_url}} --account {{account}} --default-branch {{default_branch}} --dry-run
```

Use the account chosen at pick-account. Fix any validation error (a malformed URL, a dangling account) before closing this step.

steps.title: Create the {{project}} project bead
steps.description:
```sh
gb project create {{project}} --git-url {{git_url}} --account {{account}} --default-branch {{default_branch}}
```

It writes the type:project bead only. Comment the new bead id and the list of remaining wiring that the command prints (repo push credentials and any custom roles) on this step.

steps.title: Wire the repo push credentials that gb project create reported for {{project}}
steps.description:
Human or operator step. Repo push credentials are secrets, so an agent does not create them. Do what the create step's output listed, following gardenio/docs/onboarding-new-project-and-role.md.

If you cannot do it yourself, file `gb escalation create --requesting-task <this step's id>` with the exact change, and close this step when the escalation is done.

steps.title: Verify the {{project}} project bead
steps.description:
```sh
kd list --type project       # {{project}} is listed
kd show <project-bead-id>    # git_url={{git_url}}, account and default_branch={{default_branch}} as chosen
```

Next: pour add-local-agent.json and then first-task.json from this directory.
